summary: Remove the mcp:read-only annotation from the watch command.
reason: watch --record opens the local store read-write and upserts new scenes (UpsertBatch), so a readOnlyHint:true annotation would falsely tell MCP hosts the command cannot mutate. Dropping the annotation makes the tool default to potentially-mutating, which is correct.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; verify-skill still matches shipped CLI source.
